import ast
import copy
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid

sys.path.insert(0, '/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/scripts/aws')
from aws_cli import run, result

OUT = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/testdata/aws/cloudwatch/metric_insights_contributor_samples.json')
PREFIX = 'sd-mi-samples-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
NS = 'Stackd/InsightsSamples/' + PREFIX
POLICIES = ['missing', 'ignore', 'breaching', 'notBreaching']
ALARMS = [PREFIX + '-' + p for p in POLICIES]
ENV = dict(os.environ, AWS_REGION='us-west-2', AWS_DEFAULT_REGION='us-west-2', AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1', AWS_PAGER='', AWS_IGNORE_CONFIGURED_ENDPOINT_URLS='true')
for key in list(ENV):
    if key.startswith('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL'):
        del ENV[key]
QUERY = 'SELECT MAX(Load) FROM "' + NS + '" GROUP BY Team ORDER BY MAX() DESC LIMIT 3'
EMPTY = 'SELECT MAX(Load) FROM "' + NS + '" WHERE Team = \'never-published\' GROUP BY Team ORDER BY MAX() DESC LIMIT 3'
URLS = ['https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarms-and-missing-data.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/cloudwatch-metrics-insights-limits.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/multi-time-series-alarm.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_PutMetricAlarm.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_DescribeAlarmContributors.html']
CAP = {'caller_account': '000000000000', 'region': 'us-west-2', 'started_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'cli_version': subprocess.run(['aws', '--version'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip(), 'sources': [{'url': u} for u in URLS] + [{'path': __file__, 'content': Path(__file__).read_text()}], 'owned_resources': {'alarms': ALARMS, 'namespace': NS, 'metric_name': 'Load', 'metric_identities': [{'Team': k} for k in ['a', 'b', 'c']]}, 'protocol': {'period_seconds': 60, 'evaluation_periods': 3, 'datapoints_to_alarm': 2, 'threshold': 10, 'policies': POLICIES, 'maximum_owned_alarm_names': 4, 'maximum_metric_identities': 3, 'maximum_metric_samples': 60, 'phase_deadline_seconds': 240, 'poll_interval_seconds': 20, 'actions_enabled': False, 'account_settings_modified': False, 'publication': 'Explicit recent UTC timestamps; sparse phase is published once only. No future samples and no SetAlarmState. Admission requests reuse the first owned alarm name before the simultaneous four-alarm behavioral experiment.'}, 'observations': [], 'phases': [], 'cleanup': [], 'published_metric_samples': 0}
CHECKED = False

def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

def stamp(t):
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(t, timezone.utc).isoformat()

def save():
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(CAP, indent=2) + '\n')

def call(label, operation, params, service='cloudwatch', cleanup=False):
    frozen = copy.deepcopy(params)
    start = time.time()
    p = run(service, operation, frozen, ENV, options=('--debug', '--no-paginate', '--cli-connect-timeout', '10', '--cli-read-timeout', '25'), timeout=40)
    decoded = result(p, debug=True, cli_message=None)
    for line in reversed(p.stderr.splitlines()):
        if 'Response headers:' in line:
            try:
                headers = ast.literal_eval(line.split('Response headers:', 1)[1].strip())
                for k, v in headers.items():
                    if k.lower() in ('x-amzn-requestid', 'x-amzn-request-id'):
                        decoded['request_id'] = v
            except (ValueError, SyntaxError):
                pass
            break
    if service == 'sts' and decoded['code'] == 'Success':
        decoded['output'].pop('UserId', None)
    CAP['cleanup' if cleanup else 'observations'].append({'label': label, 'service': service, 'operation': operation, 'input': frozen, 'request_started_ms': round(start * 1000), 'request_finished_ms': round(time.time() * 1000), 'result': copy.deepcopy(decoded)})
    save()
    print(label, decoded['code'], flush=True)
    return decoded

def require(response):
    if response['code'] != 'Success':
        raise RuntimeError(response['code'] + ': ' + response.get('message', ''))
    return response.get('output', {})

def config(label, policy, expression=QUERY, period=60, n=3, m=2):
    return call(label, 'put-metric-alarm', {'AlarmName': PREFIX + '-' + policy, 'ComparisonOperator': 'GreaterThanThreshold', 'EvaluationPeriods': n, 'DatapointsToAlarm': m, 'Threshold': 10, 'ActionsEnabled': False, 'TreatMissingData': policy, 'Metrics': [{'Id': 'q', 'Expression': expression, 'Period': period, 'ReturnData': True}]})

def publish(label, samples):
    if CAP['published_metric_samples'] + len(samples) > 60:
        raise RuntimeError('Metric sample cap reached')
    points = [{'MetricName': 'Load', 'Dimensions': [{'Name': 'Team', 'Value': k}], 'Timestamp': stamp(t), 'Value': v, 'Unit': 'Count'} for k, t, v in samples]
    require(call(label, 'put-metric-data', {'Namespace': NS, 'MetricData': points}))
    CAP['published_metric_samples'] += len(points)
    save()

def query(label, expression):
    end = int(time.time() // 60) * 60
    return require(call(label, 'get-metric-data', {'StartTime': stamp(end - 420), 'EndTime': stamp(end), 'MetricDataQueries': [{'Id': 'q', 'Expression': expression, 'Period': 60, 'ReturnData': True}], 'ScanBy': 'TimestampDescending'}))

def history(label):
    for policy, name in zip(POLICIES, ALARMS):
        require(call(label + '-' + policy, 'describe-alarm-history', {'AlarmName': name, 'MaxRecords': 100, 'ScanBy': 'TimestampAscending'}))

def phase(label, expression, duration, publish_values=None, early=None):
    start = time.time()
    record = {'name': label, 'started_at': now(), 'deadline_seconds': duration, 'expression': expression, 'snapshots': [], 'stop_reason': 'bounded deadline'}
    CAP['phases'].append(record)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + duration
    published = set()
    i = 0
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        i += 1
        prefix = label + '-poll-' + str(i)
        if publish_values:
            minute = int(time.time() // 60) * 60
            if minute not in published:
                publish(prefix + '-publish', [(k, time.time(), v) for k, v in publish_values.items()])
                published.add(minute)
        alarms = require(call(prefix + '-alarms', 'describe-alarms', {'AlarmNames': ALARMS}))
        snapshot = {'observed_at': now(), 'alarms': {}}
        for policy, name in zip(POLICIES, ALARMS):
            cs = require(call(prefix + '-contributors-' + policy, 'describe-alarm-contributors', {'AlarmName': name}))
            alarm = next((a for a in alarms.get('MetricAlarms', []) if a['AlarmName'] == name), {})
            reason = json.loads(alarm.get('StateReasonData', '{}'))
            qd = reason.get('queryDate')
            snapshot['alarms'][policy] = {'state': alarm.get('StateValue'), 'state_reason': alarm.get('StateReason'), 'state_reason_data': reason, 'state_transitioned_timestamp': alarm.get('StateTransitionedTimestamp'), 'fresh_query_date_since_phase_start': bool(qd and datetime.fromisoformat(qd.replace('Z', '+00:00')).timestamp() > start), 'contributors': cs.get('AlarmContributors', [])}
        snapshot['query_control'] = query(prefix + '-query', expression)
        if expression != QUERY:
            snapshot['positive_unfiltered_query_control'] = query(prefix + '-unfiltered-query', QUERY)
        record['snapshots'].append(snapshot)
        save()
        print('SNAPSHOT', label, {p: (a['state'], [c.get('ContributorAttributes') for c in a['contributors']], a['fresh_query_date_since_phase_start']) for p, a in snapshot['alarms'].items()}, flush=True)
        if early and early(snapshot):
            record['stop_reason'] = 'observed requested positive transition with fresh query dates'
            break
        time.sleep(min(20, max(0, deadline - time.monotonic())))
    record['ended_at'] = now()
    save()
    history(label + '-history')
    return record

try:
    identity = require(call('identity', 'get-caller-identity', {}, service='sts'))
    if identity.get('Account') != '000000000000' or identity.get('Arn') != 'arn:aws:iam::000000000000:user/Delegated':
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected caller; no resources touched')
    CHECKED = True
    CAP['actor_arn'] = identity['Arn']
    require(call('owned-names-initial-absence', 'describe-alarms', {'AlarmNames': ALARMS}))
    admissions = [(30, 3), (60, 179), (60, 180), (60, 181), (300, 36), (300, 37), (10800, 1), (10860, 1)]
    for period, n in admissions:
        config('admission-period-' + str(period) + '-n-' + str(n), 'missing', period=period, n=n, m=1)
    require(call('admission-final-describe', 'describe-alarms', {'AlarmNames': [ALARMS[0]]}))
    require(call('delete-admission-alarm', 'delete-alarms', {'AlarmNames': [ALARMS[0]]}))
    t = int(time.time() // 60) * 60
    publish('sparse-once', [('a', t - 60, 20), ('b', t - 60, 5), ('c', t - 180, 30), ('c', t - 60, 30)])
    for policy in POLICIES:
        require(config('create-sparse-' + policy, policy))
    phase('sparse-and-aging', QUERY, 240)
    # Re-seed a positive, fresh evaluated contributor before forcing empty query.
    t = int(time.time() // 60) * 60
    publish('positive-breach-seed', [(k, t + offset, v) for k, v in [('a', 25), ('b', 5), ('c', 35)] for offset in [-120, -60]])
    phase('positive-breach', QUERY, 180, {'a': 25, 'b': 5, 'c': 35}, lambda s: all(a['state'] == 'ALARM' and a['contributors'] and a['fresh_query_date_since_phase_start'] for a in s['alarms'].values()))
    for policy in POLICIES:
        require(config('empty-query-' + policy, policy, EMPTY))
    phase('disappearance-empty-query', EMPTY, 180, {'a': 25, 'b': 5, 'c': 35}, lambda s: all(not a['contributors'] for a in s['alarms'].values()) and s['alarms']['missing']['state'] == 'INSUFFICIENT_DATA' and s['alarms']['notBreaching']['state'] == 'OK' and s['alarms']['breaching']['state'] == 'ALARM')
    for policy in POLICIES:
        require(config('restore-query-' + policy, policy))
    phase('positive-nonbreaching-recovery', QUERY, 240, {'a': 2, 'b': 3, 'c': 4}, lambda s: all(a['state'] == 'OK' and not a['contributors'] and a['fresh_query_date_since_phase_start'] for a in s['alarms'].values()))
except BaseException as exc:
    CAP['probe_error'] = str(exc)
    save()
    raise
finally:
    if CHECKED:
        require(call('delete-owned-alarms', 'delete-alarms', {'AlarmNames': ALARMS}, cleanup=True))
        remaining = require(call('verify-owned-alarm-absence', 'describe-alarms', {'AlarmNames': ALARMS}, cleanup=True))
        CAP['cleanup_verified'] = not remaining.get('MetricAlarms') and not remaining.get('CompositeAlarms')
    CAP['metric_retention'] = 'Published custom metric samples cannot be deleted using CloudWatch APIs; only these three uniquely namespaced metric identities remain until AWS retention expires.'
    CAP['completed_at'] = now()
    save()

from pathlib import Path

prior = json.loads(Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/testdata/aws/cloudwatch/metric_insights_contributor_samples.json').read_text())

exec(compile(original.split("try:\n    identity = require(", 1)[0], '<embedded-sample-probe-helpers>', 'exec'), globals())
CAP = prior
ALARMS = CAP['owned_resources']['alarms']
CAP['sources'].append({'path': __file__, 'invocation': 'explicit-contributor-history-after-cleanup', 'content': Path(__file__).read_text()})
identity = require(call('history-followup-identity', 'get-caller-identity', {}, service='sts'))
if identity.get('Account') != '000000000000' or identity.get('Arn') != 'arn:aws:iam::000000000000:user/Delegated':
    raise RuntimeError('Unexpected caller')
for name in ALARMS:
    require(call('explicit-contributor-history-' + name.rsplit('-', 1)[-1], 'describe-alarm-history', {'AlarmName': name, 'HistoryItemType': 'AlarmContributorStateUpdate', 'MaxRecords': 100, 'ScanBy': 'TimestampAscending'}))

CAP['cleanup_verified'] = not remaining.get('MetricAlarms') and not remaining.get('CompositeAlarms')
CAP['completed_at'] = now()
save()

admission.scope: All admissions used the actual grouped ORDER BY Metrics Insights expression with M=1. No scalar SQL admission control or long-window evaluation was performed.

sparse_n3_m2.single_aging_breach: Under missing, a transitioned to ALARM at 20:57:31.649Z with only its 20:55:00Z breach. Its reason explicitly says 1 out of the last 3 datapoints breached despite minimum 2 datapoints for OK -> ALARM. This observes the scalar-style aging-breach rule in a selected grouped contributor.
sparse_n3_m2.single_nonbreach: Under breaching, b transitioned to ALARM with only one received nonbreaching datapoint and two missing datapoints treated as Breaching. It subsequently transitioned to OK when three actual nonbreaching datapoints were received.
sparse_n3_m2.two_sparse_breaches: c transitioned to ALARM under all four policies despite only two nonconsecutive real samples. Breaching and notBreaching reasons explicitly mention filling the remaining one datapoint with their respective policies.
sparse_n3_m2.scalar_semantics_comparison: The observed per-contributor sparse decisions agree with the documented scalar M-of-N filling and aging-breach semantics; no separate scalar-alarm experiment was run. The grouped-specific difference is disappearance handling and parent empty-query policy, not the observed individual-sample decisions.
sparse_n3_m2.non_alarm_visibility_limit: DescribeAlarmContributors returned only active ALARM contributors. Absence of a or b from another policy's list is not a separately observed initial OK transition.

empty_query.mechanism: All four queries were updated to WHERE Team = 'never-published'; publishing the original three identities continued. The empty filtered GetMetricData result and positive unfiltered query control are captured together.
empty_query.contributors: All four active contributor lists became empty. Explicit AlarmContributorStateUpdate histories show a and c transitioning to OK for every policy with exact reason 'No data was returned for this contributor'. Parent ignore retained ALARM even though its former contributors transitioned to OK; parent breaching also remained ALARM with no active contributors.
empty_query.evaluation_proof: All four parent reason queryDate values advanced after the empty-query update; missing and notBreaching changed state, while ignore and breaching retained ALARM with new empty-query reasons.

positive_recovery.outcome: After restoring the original query, actual recent breach samples first produced ALARM contributors a and c under all policies. Continued nonbreaching a=2,b=3,c=4 samples then produced fresh OK parent evaluations and empty active contributor lists under all four policies.
positive_recovery.contributor_proof: Explicit history contains ALARM -> OK transitions for a and c with reasons identifying two of the last three real datapoints as nonbreaching, not disappearance.

evaluation_limits: The positive-breach phase reached its 180-second bound because missing retained its earlier parent queryDate/reason. The other three policies produced fresh reason changes and contributor transitions. The unchanged missing reason is not claimed as a fresh evaluation.

The sparse-and-aging phase retained unchanged reasons after the observed initial transitions. It does not prove continued evaluation, natural time-series expiry, the precise lookback length, or state decisions at each subsequent poll.
Empty-query disappearance was deliberately induced by a query filter change, not claimed as natural aging beyond the lookback.
Fresh_query_date_since_phase_start only compares a retained reason timestamp with the phase start. It does not mean every snapshot contains a new evaluation.
GetMetricData controls queried seven recent minutes, independently of the alarm's internal evaluation range. Exact API timestamps retain their returned offsets.
Alarms evaluated asynchronously; simultaneous equivalent configurations do not imply identical evaluation instants.
Default DescribeAlarmHistory omitted contributor items; the explicit AlarmContributorStateUpdate follow-up after deletion recovered and retained the actual transitions.

metric_retention: Published custom metric samples cannot be deleted using CloudWatch APIs; only these three uniquely namespaced metric identities remain until AWS retention expires.
